title: Weber-overnight preregistered target runs: machine summary
status: complete: controls rerun recorded first (11/11), all 15 preregistered cases run at rtol 1e-12 and 1e-10, predicted cases compared, withheld cases recorded without comparison
worker: henri-poincare lens (subject lane), weber-overnight target runs
grade: measured by the subject instrument (double-precision GBS integration with event location); not an enclosure; agreement with the subject reduction shares no code but was authored in the same lane; the independent reference comparison is done separately by the PI

controlsRerun.note: The committed receipt weber-overnight-pair-instrument-controls.json was not rewritten; the rerun receipt went to scratch via --receipt.

conventions.frame: absolute (void) frame; centre of velocity at rest unless the case says otherwise
conventions.members: member index 0 is the subject's member 1 (initial position +rho/2, velocity +w/2); index 1 is member 2
conventions.circles: relative speed sqrt(2K/r) from h^2 = 2Kr, each member at half the relative velocity
conventions.apsidalAngle: unwrapped relative angle between successive turning points (pericentre to apocentre); the pericentre-to-pericentre angle is twice this
conventions.speedLabels: strict: supremum below c_f with no crossing; inclusive: equality only on the WB-3 boundary circle (round-off crossings); unrestricted: a recorded rising crossing of c_f

anomalies: WB-6 and WC-1 at the refinement tolerance (rtol 1e-10, preregistered hmax): the integrator stepped across the contact window r < 1e-6 (width about 1.4e-6 in time at relative speed sqrt 2) in one step, so the contact event was not raised; the state passed through r = 0 (located as a turning point with r ~ 1e-15 at the pass-through time) and the continuation beyond that point is not a regular history (candidate H drifted by order unity, speeds exceeded c_f). The pass-through time agrees with the extrapolated zero-separation time of the rtol 1e-12 run to about 1e-12. A rerun at rtol 1e-10 with hmax = 1e-3 also stepped over the window. This is the documented event-location limitation (at most one sign change per step), made likely here because the frozen law reaches contact at finite speed and finite acceleration.

WB-8 terminated by step underflow at r = 2 + 1.3e-7 (det = 6.7e-8) before the determinant obstruction threshold 1e-8 was reached: the individual speed diverged (1250 at the stop) faster than the step controller could follow. The first recorded event is the speed-equality crossing; the stop time agrees with the predicted time of reaching x = 2 to 1.2e-10 relative.

WB-3 recorded 16 (rtol 1e-12) and 2 (rtol 1e-10) speed-equality crossings with |speed - 1| at or below 4e-16; they are round-off departures from the prepared equality circle and are not dynamical crossings.
WB-7: the kick (0.005, 0, 0.01) on member 1 adds half of itself to the centre velocity, so the measured centre velocity is (0.0525, 0, 0.005), not (0.05, 0, 0).
